content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָכִֽילוּ גוֹיִם זַעְמוֹ?
content.transliteration: Mi ka’Adonai asher lo yakhilu ḡoyim za‘mo?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, whose rage nations cannot withstand?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   הַמֵּפִיר עֲצַת בָּלָק, וְשִׁנָּה טַעְמוֹ?
content.transliteration: Mi ka’Adonai hammefir ‘atsat Balaḳ, veshinna ta‘mo?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who thwarted Balak’s plot, and changed his intention?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   רָב תָּמִיד רִיבֵי עַמּוֹ?
content.transliteration: Mi ka’Adonai rav tamid rivē ‘ammo?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, [who] constantly fights His people’s fights?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   נָתַן בְּפִי בִלְעָם נֹאֲמוֹ?
content.transliteration: Mi ka’Adonai natan befi vil‘am no’amo?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, [who] placed His speech in Balaam’s mouth?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   רָאָה לִבּוֹ נָבוֹךְ, וְהֵחֵל לְפַעֲמוֹ?
content.transliteration: Mi ka’Adonai ra’a libbo navokh, veheḥel lefa‘amo?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, [who] saw that [Balaam’s] heart was confused, and began to kick him?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   בְּקוֹל פְּחָדִים קִדְּמוֹ?
content.transliteration: Mi ka’Adonai beḳol peḥadim ḳiddemo?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, [who] preceded him with a fearsome voice?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   פָּתַח פִּי אֲתוֹנוֹ וְהִכְלִימוֹ?
content.transliteration: Mi ka’Adonai pataḥ pi atono vehikhlimo?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, [who] opened the mouth of his she-ass, and humiliated him?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   גִּלָּה עֵינָיו וֶהֱקִיצוֹ מֵחֲלוֹמוֹ?
content.transliteration: Mi ka’Adonai gilla ‘enav veheḳitso meḥalomo?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, [who] unveiled his eyes, and woke him from his dream?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   לְבָרֵךְ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל הָפַךְ זְמָמוֹ?
content.transliteration: Mi ka’Adonai levarekh et Yisra’el hafakh zemamo?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, [who] turned his plot into a blessing for Israel?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   לְדַבֵּר עֲתִידוֹת הֶעֱרִימוֹ?
content.transliteration: Mi ka’Adonai ledabber ‘atidot he‘erimo?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, [who] gave [Balaam] wisdom to tell the future?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   הֵשִׁיק לְאֹהֲבָיו נֹעֲמוֹ?
content.transliteration: Mi ka’Adonai heshiḳ le’ohavav no‘amo?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, [who] inundated those who love Him with sweetness?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   מַשְׁגִּֽיחַ לְדָרֵי הֲדוֹמוֹ?
content.transliteration: Mi ka’Adonai mashgi’aḥ ledarē hadomo?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, [who] watches out for those who dwell on His footstool?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   גִּלָּה מִשְׁפָּטָיו מִמְּרוֹמוֹ?
content.transliteration: Mi ka’Adonai gilla mishpatav mimmeromo?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, [who] revealed His laws from on high?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   אֲשֶׁר אֵין תִּכְלָה לְתַעֲצוּמוֹ?
content.transliteration: Mi ka’Adonai asher en tikhla leta‘atsumo?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, whose mightiness has no limit?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   לֹא נוֹדָע מְקוֹמוֹ?
content.transliteration: Mi ka’Adonai lo noda‘ meḳomo?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, [whose] place is unknown?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   הֵרִים לְפִינְחָס, כִּי יָדַע שְׁמוֹ?
content.transliteration: Mi ka’Adonai herim lefineḥas, ki yada‘ shemo?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, [who] raised up Phineas, for He knew his name?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   הִרְבָּה לְדֹר וָדֹר שְׁלוֹמוֹ?
content.transliteration: Mi ka’Adonai hirba ledor vador shelomo?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, [who] gave him great peace, for generation after generation?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   לִכְהֻנַּת עוֹלָם שָׂמוֹ?
content.transliteration: Mi ka’Adonai likhunnat ‘olam samo?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, [who] set him for an eternal priesthood?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   בָּחַר בְּיַעֲקֹב, יוי אֱלֹהָיו עִמּוֹ?
content.transliteration: Mi ka’Adonai baḥar beYa‘aḳov, Adonai elohav ‘immo?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, [who] chose Jacob—Adonai his God is with him?

content.hebrew: קהל: מִי כַּיוי   הִגִּיד בְּכִתְבֵי חוֹתָמוֹ?
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Mi ka’Adonai higgid bekhitvē ḥotamo?
content.english: Cong. Who is like Adonai, [who] informed [us] in the writings bearing His seal?

content.hebrew: חזן: כִּֽי־יַֽעֲקֹ֗ב בָּחַ֣ר ל֣וֹ יָ֑הּ יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל לִסְגֻלָּתֽוֹ: (תהלים קלה:ד)
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Ki Ya‘aḳov baḥar lo Yah Yisra’el lisḡullato:
content.english: Cantor. For Yah has chosen Jacob, Israel for His treasured [people]. (Ps. 135:4)

content.hebrew: שְׁמַ֤ע אֵלַי֙ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מְקֹֽרָאִ֑י אֲנִי־הוּא֙ אֲנִ֣י רִאשׁ֔וֹן אַ֖ף אֲנִ֥י אַֽחֲרֽוֹן: (ישעיהו מח:יב)
content.transliteration: Shema‘ elai Ya‘aḳov veYisra’el meḳora’i ani hu ani rishon af ani aḥaron:
content.english: Hear me Jacob, and Israel who are called by Me: I am He, I am the first, and I am also the last. (Isa. 48:12)

content.hebrew: קהל: שְׁמַ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יו֥י אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ יו֥י ׀ אֶחָֽד: (דברים ו:ד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Shema‘ Yisra’el Adonai elohenu Adonai, eḥad:
content.english: Cong. Hear O Israel, Adonai our God is Adonai on His own. (Deut. 6:4)
content.comments: Adonai on His own. The translation follows Sefer Ha-mivḥar, on Deuteronomy 6:4: “The meaning is that He is one and does not need any second one.”
